content.title: Neon Siege Decision | Lone Route, Drone Convergence and Defensive Hold
content.summary: An adult signal ranger walks into a drone ring and raises one shield. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject and one destination axis persist. + Threat count and proximity increase monotonically. + The visor warning agrees with visible positions. + Exactly one final decision gesture occurs. + The sequence stops before inventing victory or injury.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish an empty rain-lit port avenue before one adult signal ranger walks into frame. Increase to nine drones in a readable ring, preserving the street and beacon direction. The ranger turns once, raises one pulse shield and holds before any attack outcome is invented.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject and one destination axis persist.
Threat count and proximity increase monotonically.
Exactly one final decision gesture occurs.
The sequence stops before inventing victory or injury.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult signal ranger walks into a drone ring and raises one shield. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 从雨夜空城和同一成年战士的独行路线开始，无人机由远到近汇聚；头盔警报确认威胁后，人物转身举起装备，停在行动前的明确决断状态。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject and one destination axis persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject and one destination axis persist."

invariants.rule: Threat count and proximity increase monotonically.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Threat count and proximity increase monotonically."

invariants.rule: The visor warning agrees with visible positions.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The visor warning agrees with visible positions."

invariants.rule: Exactly one final decision gesture occurs.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one final decision gesture occurs."

invariants.rule: The sequence stops before inventing victory or injury.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The sequence stops before inventing victory or injury."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
